title: Scheduled maintenance: NBN Karringal/Frankston (VIC)
current_summary: We will perform maintenance at the NBN connection point for Karringal/Frankston (VIC) from 12:00 am to 3:00 am AEDT on 14 October 2026. Some NBN services in this area may experience interruptions of up to 3 hours during the window.

cause.reason: NNI rehoming at the NBN Karringal/Frankston Point of Interconnect

updates.content: Scheduled maintenance will take place at the NBN connection point for Karringal/Frankston (VIC) from 12:00 am to 3:00 am AEDT on 14 October 2026. During this window, some NBN services served by this POI may experience one or more interruptions, up to a total of 3 hours, while we relocate network links (NNI rehoming). We will work to keep any downtime as short as possible.
